analysis_concurrency: three independent processes; no shared monkeypatch state
scope: decision stability and internal avatar queue payload; not rendered avatar/browser E2E
stability: mean pairwise within-old, within-new, cross-variant label disagreement per text; equal text weights
uncertainty: bootstrap by the 12 scenario families across languages; 5000 resamples, fixed seed
semantic_blinding: judge sees reply and 17 candidates only; no old/new label, chosen emoji, emotion, or source
semantic_order_check: deterministically shuffled candidates and reversed candidate order per text
semantic_comparator: uniform expected score over candidates for the SAME final emotion; also separate end-to-end both-eligible comparison
semantic_unit: average over repeated new outputs per text; equal text weights, no treating repeats as independent
limits: model scores are not human gold
explicit anchor expected labels derive from textual rule construction, not historical manual annotations
